gloss: to bite; to snap at; to lash out at

definitions.gloss: to bite; to sink one's teeth into
definitions.explanation: To bite and hold on, especially said of animals. Describes an aggressive biting action rather than a gentle nibble.

definitions.gloss: to lash out at; to attack verbally; to snap at
definitions.explanation: To aggressively confront or criticize someone, often in an emotional or combative way. Used figuratively for verbal attacks.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{噛|か}む→噛む：01205_kamu⟧ (to bite) and つく (to attach, cling). The つく adds the nuance of latching on or holding fast after biting. Often written in kana as かみつく.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{噛|か}みつかれる: to be bitten by a dog
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{噛|か}みつく: to bite someone's hand
- ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{噛|か}みつく: to lash out at one's opponent
- {噛|か}みつく⟦ように{言|い}う→〜ように言う：29170_youniiu⟧: to say bitingly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{噛|か}む→噛む：01205_kamu⟧: to bite, chew — general biting without the nuance of latching on
- {食|く}いつく: to bite into — emphasizes gripping with the teeth; also used figuratively for showing keen interest
- ⟦{吠|ほ}える→吠える：02415_hoeru⟧: to bark, howl — aggressive vocal behavior from an animal, but no physical contact
